Driven in a booted guest of the subject artifact (e906a48793d7, image sha256:c87a6616..., 1920x1080, llvmpipe). The preference was set via the guest's own gsettings, read back, and the screen photographed; a control screenshot at restored settings measures the run's own noise floor (6.91% of the screen, dominated by the live Companion animation and system gauges - localised in noise-mask.png, not hidden). high-contrast changed 99.6% of the screen (14.4x the noise floor): the wallpaper is replaced by the theme's opaque ground, borders replace shadows, and the palette switches to the high-contrast theme (tests/shell/test_companion_surfaces.py::test_high_contrast_exists_as_a_theme_rather_than_a_wish and the contrast-pair gate fail if that is removed). Observed limitation, recorded not hidden: the first-run GTK dialog keeps its GTK theme; the shell is what this scenario measures.

Driven in a booted guest of the subject artifact (e906a48793d7, image sha256:c87a6616..., 1920x1080, llvmpipe). The preference was set via the guest's own gsettings, read back, and the screen photographed; a control screenshot at restored settings measures the run's own noise floor (6.91% of the screen, dominated by the live Companion animation and system gauges - localised in noise-mask.png, not hidden). The direct measurement is AT-SPI control geometry: at 1.5x, 19 of 60 comparable controls grew and none shrank (conclusive). The screen corroborates: 41.5% changed (6.0x the noise floor). The mechanism is the generated stylesheet - every font size is a theme value multiplied by the scale; tests/shell/test_design_system.py::test_no_font_size_survives_a_change_of_scale fails if that is removed.

Still NOT_RUN after the 2026-08-12 accessibility pass, for two reasons. The pass photographed the screen rather than filming it, and a still cannot show whether a transition animated. And the guest's own log reads 'mutter reports rendering is software' then 'animations are disabled; the character is drawn in a resting pose' - under llvmpipe the desktop turns animations off by itself, so the preference had nothing left to switch off. Measuring this needs frame capture AND hardware rendering. The desktop does pin its motion budget to 0 under reduced motion in source (companionPresence.js, taskWorkspace.js), but recording a pass from source inspection is what this matrix refuses.
